messages:
rachel: Quick brain-dump: thinking about an "inline triage" card for auto-fallbacks so oncall can see cause + action without reading audit logs. minimal, non-PII.

tom: love it. card should include: severity pill, short cause enum, p95 badge, est cost delta, and a single 'Inspect' link. no raw request text.

priya: API-wise let's return a flat row: decision_id, ts, cause, policy, rule, p95_ms, err_pct, sample_pct, org_hash, override_state. keeps indexing cheap.

dan: operator overrides: temp (TTL default 10m) and permanent (requires ticket + approver). show TTL countdown on the card.

ops-bot: alert: fallback_rate(api-ingest) = 2.6% over 5m -> paging @oncall-sre :rotating_light:

rachel: privacy: store sha256(prefix)+token_count+redaction_flag. show 'sampled snippet gated' only for data-access roles. priya: noted. i'll draft API + telemetry PR.

tom: agree on TTL=10m default. rachel: please add a small microcopy line: "Routed to Quiet Degrade 6#8212; p95 spike" and I'll mock the figma card.

rachel: will do. if no objections i'll open a short RFC tomorrow and attach mocks. thanks. :raised_hands:
